faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IRCON Manager/Rajbhasha recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to receive the application form along with all requisite documents is 23rd October 2026. Ensure your application reaches the corporate office by this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Manager/Rajbhasha post?
faq.answer: Candidates must have a Master's degree in Hindi with English at the degree level or vice-versa, along with a full-time Diploma in Translation of at least one year's duration.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Manager/Rajbhasha position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Manager/Rajbhasha post is 37 years. Age relaxation is applicable as per government guidelines.

faq.question: Q4. How many vacancies are available for the Manager/Rajbhasha post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the post of Manager/Rajbhasha (E-3) in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Manager/Rajbhasha role?
faq.answer: The salary for the Manager/Rajbhasha post is in the scale of Rs. 60000-180000/- per month, along with allowances and Performance Related Pay (PRP).

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is offline. Candidates need to send their applications by post.

faq.question: Q7. Does IRCON offer any age relaxation for specific categories?
faq.answer: Yes, age relaxation is applicable for IRCON's departmental/contractual employees as per the extant Recruitment Rules of IRCON and also as per Government of India guidelines.

faq.question: Q8. What documents are required to be submitted with the application form?
faq.answer: Required documents include Matriculation certificate for DOB proof, all qualification certificates and marksheets, experience certificates, community certificate (if applicable), and valid ID proof.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any application fee for SC/ST/EWS/PWD/Ex-Serviceman candidates?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee for candidates belonging to SC/ST/EWS/PWD/Ex-Serviceman categories.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be downloaded from the official website of IRCON, which is www.ircon.org.
